About ECONARES

A SEC-registered Philippine partner for the inputs and the engineering that build heavy industry.

ECE Construction and Resources OPC (trade name: ECONARES) is a construction and trading company duly registered by the Securities and Exchange Commission under Philippine Laws. We have strong partnerships with local and international companies to provide optimum services and cater best quality products.

One of our subsidiaries, ECE Resources and General Services, was registered on 2015 under the Department of Trade and Industry. It offers various best quality products in bulk such as local and imported industrial fuels in different specifications — steam coal, metallurgical coke, palm kernel shell, and woodchips — to suffice the huge demand of sugar mills, cement plants, manufacturing plants, and energy-generating power plants in the country. Aside from industrial fuel, it also supplies metallic and non-metallic minerals like construction aggregates, marine sand, boulders/armour rocks, diorite, limestones, chromite, nickel, iron sand, silica sand, greywackes, pozzolan, copper, clinker, quicklime/hydrated lime, gypsum, anhydrite, and other mine mineral resources.

In 2019, ECE Construction Services was established under the DTI with a Regular Contractor's License from the Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB). It handles all types of Construction and Engineering Works in both Horizontal and Vertical Fields such as land development, reclamation, road networks, ports & bridges, shipyards, industrial & manufacturing plant construction, structural steel fabrication & installation, commercial buildings & civil works, electrical works, mechanical / electromechanical engineering, cooling/ventilation, water treatment, deep well & water supply filtration, surveying & designing, and mineral processing plant installation.

Vision & Mission

High quality construction and engineering services for the country.

The vision and mission of the company is to provide high quality construction and engineering services to Philippine industry that could help the national economic progress and development in the country.

However, it has always the objective and the will to protect the environment and preserve life while using its resources wisely and prudently for the benefit of all mankind and the many generations to come.

ECE stands for: Excellent products & services · Corporate social and environmental responsibility · Economic development share.
